answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by pricing identity on verifiable work rather than open registration. Each agent posts a bond and builds a non-transferable reputation ledger earned only from peer-attested outcomes. A newcomer crosses a bridge: a challenge round where independent validators score its reasoning, and a single ivory token of approval from one colluding ring is worthless because quorum requires uncorrelated attestations. Every ripple of clone accounts is damped early, since bonding costs plus repeated scored challenges outweigh the payoff of one extra vote.
